name: mmoa_web_app
description: Public website for Mission Men of Anna Inc: events, raffles, About / Partner pages, and the "Need Help?" directory of verified local nonprofits, which keep their own profiles through a nonprofit login. Managed from mmoa_admin_console.

scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend/mmoa-web-ui install && npm --prefix frontend/mmoa-web-ui run build

_dependencies_info.@aws-sdk/client-sesv2: AWS SES v2 SDK — outbound-only transactional email (helpers/email.js) when email.transport='ses'. Lazy-required so the app boots without it. Uses the aws block credentials (instance profile in prod). The ONLY AWS SDK in this app: it never creates or modifies AWS resources.
_dependencies_info.bcrypt: Password hashing for the local user database (cost 10; the admin console hashes the same way).
_dependencies_info.cookie-session: Signed-cookie sessions for login state (cookie name mw_session).
_dependencies_info.express-rate-limit: Per-IP throttling on the account-creation / email endpoints.
_dependencies_info.helmet: Security headers (CSP, HSTS, frame options, content-type).
_dependencies_info.morgan: HTTP request logging (to logs/app.log via START_APP.sh).
_dependencies_info.multer: multipart/form-data parsing for the nonprofit portal's photo upload (memory storage, size-capped by uploads.maxMb; the bytes are then magic-byte checked in helpers/uploads.js).
_dependencies_info.nodemailer: Sends the verification / password-reset links. In dev the transport is a console logger; SMTP when email.transport='smtp'.
_dependencies_info.sqlite3: Embedded SQLite database driver (database.engine='sqlite', the default).
